description: Run a Rust project's static-analysis and style checks — Clippy (`cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets --all-features --locked --message-format=json`, honoring the project's `[lints]`/`[workspace.lints]` table and `clippy.toml`; issues bucketed by lint id: `clippy::<lint>` such as `clippy::must_use_candidate`, `clippy::missing_errors_doc`, or rustc lint names such as `missing_docs`, `unused_imports`, `unused_variables`, plus `compile-error`/`E0425`-style codes when the code doesn't build), rustfmt (`cargo fmt --all --check --message-format short`, rule id `rustfmt`, one issue per file; unstable `rustfmt.toml` options on a stable toolchain as `rustfmt-config`), and cargo-deny when a `deny.toml` exists (`cargo deny --format json check <advisories|bans|licenses|sources>`, one run per check, rule ids `cargo-deny:<check>:<code>` such as `cargo-deny:licenses:rejected`, `cargo-deny:advisories:vulnerability`, `cargo-deny:bans:duplicate`) — in any Rust crate or Cargo workspace (command-line tool, library, service). Counts warnings without `-D warnings` (so one failing crate doesn't hide the lints of the crates that depend on it) and says how many would fail a CI that denies warnings. Verifies each tool is installed before trusting a "zero issues" result, reports a missing tool as "not installed, skipped", and parses every report with one embedded stdlib Python parser into per-tool totals and per-rule-id counts with a `file:line — message` list, deduplicating the copies Cargo prints once per target (lib and lib-test). Invoke as `/iru-rust-code-quality` for the whole workspace, or `/iru-rust-code-quality <file-or-dir>[,<file-or-dir>...]` to scope the report (Clippy and rustfmt still run workspace-wide — Rust checks whole crates — and findings outside the scope are filtered out; cargo-deny is always workspace-wide). When the prompt supplies a `baseline:` (a prior per-tool/per-rule-id count or itemized list from an earlier run of this skill, e.g. captured by `iru-rust-code-one-task-group` before a task group's changes), reports only the new-vs-baseline diff per rule id. Report-only: never runs `cargo clippy --fix`, `cargo fmt` without `--check`, `cargo deny fetch`/`init`, or edits `Cargo.toml`/`deny.toml`/`clippy.toml`/`rustfmt.toml`. Use whenever the user wants a Rust lint/format/supply-chain pass called out separately from `iru-rust-test`/`iru-rust-coverage`, instead of eyeballing Clippy console output.
